name: Camp Galil
description_short: Jewish overnight camp of the Habonim Dror youth movement on 63 acres in upper Bucks County, about 30 miles north of Philadelphia. Campers live in cabins by grade and do sports, arts, performing arts, nature and outdoor adventure, a heated pool with swim lessons for younger campers, Israel education and group decision making, with one to seven week sessions.
refund_policy_summary: Deposit $750 ($375 for Taste of Galil), with $50 non-refundable. Withdraw in writing: full refund through February 28, then $200 in March, $500 in April, 20% in May, 50% June 1 to 10, and no refund after June 10.
notes: 2027 regular rates (early bird discounts ended October 15). First time campers get a lower rate: First Session $7,475, Second Session $6,285, Mini-Session Alef $4,500, Full Summer $12,275. Extra fees: $50 Habonim Dror membership, $75 security fee and medication fees. Sibling discount $150 for a second child and $250 for each further child. Need based scholarships and One Happy Camper grants for first time campers. The rates page shows no price for Mini-Session Bet or Taste of Galil Bet, and lists a $5,475 rate for June 25 to August 15 without a program name; left out. Office: 2037 Chestnut Street #2159, Philadelphia.
